## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tokenizer_type | `tokenizer_type` | Choice | `1` | `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6` | The run | Mode (3: Byte BPE; 4: WordPiece; 5/6: optional SentencePiece; Byte BPE lowercase=false) |
| text_col | `text_col` | Text | (empty) | `Required for encoding and round-trip modes; ignored by decode mode.` | The run | Text column. |
| output_mode | `output_mode` | Choice | `wide` | `wide`, `causal_windows`, `decode`, `roundtrip` | The run | Token output. |
| document_id_col | `document_id_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Unique document ID column (windows) |
| split_col | `split_col` | Text | `split` |   | The run | Source split column (windows) |
| Response column | `target_text_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Supervised fine-tuning (causal_windows output only). Each row becomes one training window: the Text column (the prompt), then this column (the answer) plus EOS. The loss counts only the answer's tokens, so the model learns to answer the prompt instead of learning to repeat it. Needs an existing vocabulary file; a row longer than one window stops the run with its document id. Empty = ordinary windows where every token is a target. |
| token_ids_col | `token_ids_col` | Text | `token_ids` | `String column containing IDs separated by spaces or commas; decode mode falls back to tok_0..tok_n when absent.` | The run | Token ID list column (decode) |
| label_col | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Label column. |
| max_length | `max_length` | Integer | `256` |   | The run | Max sequence length. |
| lowercase | `lowercase` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Convert text to lowercase. |
| padding | `padding` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Pad short sequences. |
| truncation | `truncation` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Truncate long sequences. |
| min_word_freq | `min_word_freq` | Integer | `2` |   | The run | Minimum token frequency. |
| max_vocab_size | `max_vocab_size` | Integer | `10000` |   | The run | Vocabulary cap. |
| vocab_file | `vocab_file` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Vocabulary file. |
| pad_value | `pad_value` | Integer | `0` |   | The run | Padding token id. |
| vocab_build_if_missing | `vocab_build_if_missing` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Build and save a missing vocabulary. |
| source_csv | `source_csv` | File | (empty) | `*.csv` | The editor only | Optional corpus used by the vocabulary builder. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
